title: Oracle: prepare_workspace(root) external-interface invariants (RED on HEAD)
acceptance_criteria: A single new pytest oracle file tests/harness/test_prepare_workspace_invariants.py is added.
The oracle drives prepare_workspace(root) over hermetic synthesized git and non-git roots in their own tmp_path (no live state/, no network, no live daemon).
Oracle FAILS (RED) on HEAD because prepare_workspace does not yet exist / does not enforce the gates.
Oracle asserts the fail-CLOSED invariant: a non-git root is treated DIRTY and refused, independent of target_bootstrap._is_dirty's clean-on-non-git answer.
Oracle asserts ownership, allowlist, dirty, and STAGED_UNMERGED refusal gates.
Oracle asserts the shared state_reconcile.lock is acquired and that reclamation is scoped (never a bare `git worktree prune`; siblings verified still registered).
Oracle uses mutation_target harness.state_reconciler and passes the non-vacuity gate (fails against the declared mutant).

spec.objective: Author the single hermetic pytest oracle that pins the external-interface invariants of prepare_workspace(root) in harness/state_reconciler.py: fail-CLOSED dirty (non-git root refused), ownership/allowlist/STAGED_UNMERGED gates, one shared state_reconcile.lock, and scoped staging-worktree reclamation that never runs a bare `git worktree prune`. The oracle must be RED on HEAD.
functional_requirements: Assert prepare_workspace(root) refuses a NON-GIT root by treating it as DIRTY (fail-CLOSED), and does not trust target_bootstrap._is_dirty's False/clean answer on a non-git root.
Assert the ownership gate refuses a root not owned by the harness before any mutation occurs.
Assert the allowlist gate refuses a root outside the configured allowlist before any mutation occurs.
Assert the dirty gate refuses a git root with working-tree/uncommitted changes and permits a clean owned/allowlisted git root.
Assert the STAGED_UNMERGED gate refuses a root that has staged-unmerged entries.

Assert prepare_workspace acquires the shared state_reconcile.lock and that staging-worktree reclamation is scoped — siblings are verified still registered and a bare `git worktree prune` is never invoked — while delegating the report/apply to cleanup_state.
spec.interfaces: Exercises prepare_workspace(root) -> WorkspaceStatus in harness/state_reconciler.py (alias/external entrypoint over cleanup_state(root, *, mode="report"|"apply")). Synthesizes git and non-git roots under tmp_path; stubs/observes state_reconcile_lock(state_dir) acquisition and any git worktree subprocess invocations to assert no bare prune.
edge_cases: Non-git root where target_bootstrap._is_dirty would answer clean — must still be refused as DIRTY (the load-bearing fail-CLOSED case).
Owned + allowlisted + clean git root with one registered staging worktree and a still-registered sibling — reclamation must be scoped and leave the sibling alone.
Git root with staged-unmerged entries (conflict markers in index) — refused via STAGED_UNMERGED.
Lock already held — prepare_workspace must serialize on the single shared state_reconcile.lock rather than spawning a second lock.
non_goals: No live-daemon / integration run; no live state/ directory; no network.
Does not assert disk rmtree/compaction behavior (that belongs to stale-disk-reapers behind cleanup_state).
Does not flip the autowork.state_reconcile flag.
Does not test a bare `git worktree prune` path — its absence is what is asserted.
spec.implementation_notes: Pure hermetic unit oracle in tmp_path. Build git roots with `git init` and index manipulation; build a non-git root as a plain directory. Capture any subprocess/worktree calls to prove no bare `git worktree prune`. Keep mutation_target = harness.state_reconciler so the non-vacuity gate applies the declared mutant and the authored test fails against it. RED on HEAD is expected because prepare_workspace is not yet present.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Per-test tmp_path roots: (a) plain non-git directory; (b) `git init` repos in clean, dirty-working-tree, and staged-unmerged states; (c) a git root with a registered staging worktree plus a still-registered sibling worktree. No live state/, no network.

token_budget_ratio.note: Test-authoring leaf: nearly all budget is the oracle test file itself; impl tokens kept minimal.
